campaign.name: 33: Play regression and recovery — recommissioned
campaign.objective: Complete the remaining two Play branches from the common language-only baseline, preserve every intermediate checkpoint and chat/MRI evaluation, and learn how regression and recovery behave without treating loss or short-term improvement as an admission criterion.

contract.development_stage: foundational bootstrap: early encoder and expression coordination
contract.purpose: Study regression, recovery, representation drift, and protected-material placement across declared Play trajectories. Improvement and checkpoint promotion are not campaign goals.
success_criteria: Every newly executed training session is followed by complete behavioral chat and MRI activation evidence before another training session begins.
Branches 3 and 4 each preserve an exact independent lineage from the same certified language-only baseline through all twelve ordered 500-example blocks.
The final review distinguishes historical branch 1 and 2 limitations from the clean protected-last versus protected-first branch 3 and 4 comparison.
Observed regressions, recoveries, quirks, contradictions, and representation changes are preserved as evidence without automatic promotion or ranking.
failure_criteria: Any training example is shuffled, reordered outside its declared variant, or admitted before a missing prerequisite is known.
A training session lacks its immediate behavioral chat and MRI evaluation or crosses into another branch lineage.
Training material violates the active Ninereeds identity and lesson policy or reintroduces excluded identity classifications.
A checkpoint has structurally dead or saturated core layers, non-finite training telemetry, incompatible bytes, or unverifiable parentage.
A branch is ranked, selected, promoted, or declared complete before all required evidence is available.
expected_regressions: Temporary behavioral regression and strange output during a learning valley.
Non-monotonic capability scores and protected-anchor drift followed by partial or complete recovery.
No measurable behavioral improvement even when MRI evidence changes.
Immature but sentence-like generation appropriate to early encoder and expression coordination.
contract.hypothesis: With content, lineage, optimizer policy, and dependency order held fixed, moving protected identity and multilingual material from the end to the beginning of each block will produce a distinguishable regression and recovery trajectory.
observations_sought: Behavioral chat changes after every block, including nonsensical or regressed output.
MRI activation-health and representation-drift changes after every block.
Recovery timing and whether protected-first versus protected-last placement changes it.
Pipeline leaks, invalid assumptions, and commissioning failures revealed by real execution.
